title: English Practice Quiz 0609
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: There ___ two chairs in the room.
questions.explanation: Use are with the plural noun chairs.

questions.question: ___ I borrow your pen, please?
questions.explanation: May is a polite way to ask permission.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: I like tea, coffee and milk.
I like tea coffee and milk
I like, tea coffee, and milk.
i like tea, coffee and milk
questions.explanation: Use commas to separate items in a list and capitalise the first word.

questions.question: I want ___ English fluently.
questions.explanation: Want is followed by a to-infinitive.

questions.question: Which question asks for a reason?
I enjoy ___ books.
questions.explanation: Enjoy is followed by a gerund (-ing form).

questions.question: Please close ___ door.
questions.explanation: The refers to a specific door known to the speaker and listener.

questions.question: To confirm an instruction, you can say:
options: Could you please confirm the details?
questions.explanation: Could you please confirm... is polite and precise.

questions.question: She is the ___ student in the class.
questions.explanation: Use the superlative tallest when comparing one with the whole class.
